exposure: fetal fraction of cell-free DNA at the second trimester
outcome: late spontaneous preterm birth (34+0 to 36+6 weeks gestation)
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies who underwent noninvasive prenatal testing between 14 to 25 weeks of gestation.
finding: No statistically significant association was found between the fetal fraction of cell-free DNA at the second trimester and subsequent spontaneous preterm birth in any of the preterm groups.
gest_age: From <34 weeks to >=37 weeks at birth, with noninvasive prenatal testing performed at 14 to 25 weeks gestation.
